_readme: Hand-written prose. The weekly build never touches this file. managers is keyed by site handle, seasons by year. Blank line between paragraphs.

managers.triccster:
Eight seasons in the dynasty and the same shape keeps repeating: build it, peak, fall over. 2019 opened 2-13. 2021 was 12-4. 2024 was the best team he has fielded here, 10-6 with 1,970.7 points, the most he has ever scored in this league.

Then 2025 came in at 4-13. The scoring was not the story. He put up 1,677.6, eighth in a twelve-team league, and finished eleventh. He allowed 2,011.3, which is 334 more than he scored and the widest gap of his time here.

The roster that came out the other side is not a young one. It averages 26.6 against a league average of 25.9, fourth oldest of twelve, and two players are still there from the 2019 startup. For a team coming off 4-13 in a dynasty league, that is the uncomfortable part.
managers.butterygoop:
Seven seasons, seven playoff appearances, and three titles, all in the first three years of the league: 2019, 2020 and 2021. The regular season record is 72-24.

He averages 128.5 points a game, the best in the league by more than 12. He also holds the highest score in league history, 202.6 in the 2024 quarterfinal against Zak.

He is 8-0 against T.J. and 9-1 against Colt. Joey, 8-6, and James, 5-3, have the better of their series with him.
managers.TuanonStan:
James won the 2022 title with the most one-sided final the league has had: 153.66 to 73.00 over Zach Nase. He had gone 12-2 with 1,898.8 points.

He went 12-2 again in 2023 and lost the final to Brett. After a 3-11 season in 2024 he was back in the final in 2025 and lost that one to Joey. Three finals in four years.

Seven seasons, 57-39. He is 8-3 against T.J. and 6-2 against Colt.
managers.Wallner:
Seven seasons, 56-40, and the second-highest scoring average in the league at 116.1 a game. Four straight playoff appearances from 2020 to 2023, including a final in 2020 that he lost to Anthony.

He is 10-3 against Colt and 4-10 against Anthony. The last two seasons have gone 6-8 and 5-9.

The roster still carries four players from the 2019 startup draft, second only to Zach Nase.
managers.YoungBuck04:
Zak has made the playoffs five times in seven seasons, more than anyone except Anthony, and won one playoff game. The record there is 1-5.

2025 was his best regular season, 11-3 and the top seed, and it ended in the semifinal against Joey, 132.32 to 111.46. Before the good run sat 3-11 in 2021 and 4-10 in 2022.

Seven seasons, 52-44. He is 8-4 against Zach Nase and 2-7 against Anthony.
managers.brettmn13:
Brett went 0-13 in the startup season. Four years later he won the title, and then he won it again.

2023 came from the third seed: 100.58 over Zak, 145.62 over Wallner and 134.68 to 97.06 over James. 2024 came from the top seed at 12-2 and finished with a 160.44 to 148.08 final over Joey. His playoff record is 5-1.

Seven seasons, 48-48 exactly. His best single week was 195.66 against James in 2023.
managers.Jbird531:
Joey's regular season record is 45-51, which undersells where the team is now. The first four seasons had no winning record in them, including 0-13 in 2020.

Since then: 9-5, then 11-3 and a final in 2024, then the 2025 title, with 1,975.9 regular season points, the most in the league by 273.

The roster is the youngest in the league, averaging 24.4. He is 7-1 against TrifectaRich and 4-9 against Colt.
managers.Colt45Johnson:
Seven seasons, 46-50, three playoff trips and one playoff win. The good years are good: 10-4 in 2021, and 10-4 again in 2025, when he finished third.

He leads Joey 9-4 and RebuildingRUs 7-1. Anthony, 9-1, and Wallner, 10-3, have had his number.

His highest score is 183.48 in week 2 of 2020, the best of that season. The roster is one of the youngest in the league at 25.2.
managers.thecreamer:
Zach Nase has been to two finals, 2021 and 2022, and lost both, the second one 153.66 to 73.00. Seven seasons, 50-46, four playoff trips.

He went 10-3 in the startup season and finished second in the standings. His best single week was 186.34 against Zak in 2021.

His roster is tied for the oldest in the league at 27.0, and it still holds five players from the 2019 startup draft, more than anyone else. Kirk Cousins, a sixth-round pick that year, is one of them.
managers.TrifectaRich:
Five seasons since joining in 2021. The first was the best: 9-5 and a playoff spot, lost in the quarterfinal to Wallner by 3.80. It has gone 7-7, 4-10, 3-11 and 3-11 since.

The career record is 26-44. He is 9-3 against Colt and 1-8 against Anthony. His best game was 168.66 against James in 2021.
managers.DMsourbeer:
Four seasons since 2022, 22-34. The first playoff trip came last year at 7-7 as the sixth seed, and ended in the quarterfinal against James, 100.14 to 88.96.

His best score is 143.06, in week 2 of 2025 against T.J. The series with T.J. stands 4-5.
managers.RebuildingRUs:
The team is called Guranteed 1.01, and the first three seasons earned it: 1-13, 1-13 and 2-12. 2025 was the turn, 6-8 with 1,306.5 points, up from 927.5 in 2022.

The career record is 10-46. The lowest score in league history, 32.98 in week 11 of 2023, is his. His best is 132.02 against Brett last season.

seasons.2025:
Joey's year, and it was not close. 12-5, and 2,407.4 points, which is 490 more than the next best team in the league. He owned the three highest single scores of the season too, topping out at 168.7 in week 11.

Behind him the middle jammed up. James went 12-5, Colt 11-5 and Zak 11-5, and the three of them finished within 25 points of each other for the whole season.

At the bottom, T.J. went 4-13 and still outscored three teams that finished above him. TrifectaRich took the season's lowest score, 45.6 in week 9.
seasons.2019:
The startup season. Anthony went 11-2 with the most points, 1,769.3, and won the title: 140.38 to 99.40 over Zak in the semifinal and 130.54 to 121.14 over XFIRE3 in the final.

Brett went 0-13. T.J. went 2-11. The high score of the year, 199.24, came in a consolation game.
seasons.2020:
Anthony again, 11-2 and a 135.94 to 115.36 final over John Wallner, who had gone 10-3.

Joey went 0-13 while scoring more points than two other teams. Colt scored the most, 1,721.3. T.J. scored the fewest and had the three lowest single scores of the season.
seasons.2021:
Three in a row for Anthony. He went 11-3 with 1,926.8 points, the most in the league, and beat Wallner 140.54 to 116.56 and Zach Nase 142.66 to 132.10.

T.J. went 11-3 as the second seed, lost the semifinal to Zach Nase and won the third-place game. TrifectaRich joined and made the playoffs at 9-5.
seasons.2022:
James went 12-2 with 1,898.8 points and finished it with the most lopsided final in league history, 153.66 to 73.00 over Zach Nase. It was Zach Nase's second straight final loss, and the end of Anthony's run of titles at three.

DMsourbeer and RebuildingRUs joined. RebuildingRUs went 1-13.
seasons.2023:
Brett's first title, from the third seed. He beat Zak, then Wallner 145.62 to 114.48, then James 134.68 to 97.06. His 195.66 in week 5 was the best score of the season.

James went 12-2 for the second year running, with 1,900.1 points, and lost the final. RebuildingRUs went 1-13 again and posted the lowest score in league history, 32.98.
seasons.2024:
Brett again, this time from the top seed at 12-2: 100.90 to 94.78 over Zach Nase and 160.44 to 148.08 over Joey. Five years after going 0-13.

Anthony put up 202.6 against Zak in the quarterfinal, the highest score in league history, and lost the semifinal to Joey a week later. Joey scored the most points, 1,805.9. James went 3-11 a year after 12-2.
